sourceQuote: No Objection Letter(N.O.C.) from the pervious university if you are a transfer student A student who has studied in China and wants to transfer to another university must provide the N.O.C. from original university.
targetQuote: 7.原就读大学出具的无异议函（N.O.C.） 适用于转学学生 曾在就读中国高校并希望转学至其他大学的学生，须提供原就读大学出具的无异议函。
